How the day goes

You point. We carry. We sort.

  1. Point and price on site. The number you hear is the number on the sheet.
  2. Crew carries, you do not lift. Dollies, straps, floors protected.
  3. We sort: donate what is usable, recycle metal and foam, landfill last. Blue tape on anything you want to keep — we check drawers before anything goes.
